about.summary: Final-year Systems and Informatics Engineering student at Universidad Pontificia Bolivariana (UPB) in Colombia. Combining rigorous algorithmic problem-solving with proven industry experience delivering production applications end-to-end across cloud, distributed backends, and full-stack systems.

highlights.detail: Honor Scholarship recipient for academic excellence with term GPAs of 4.86 / 5.0 and 4.93 / 5.0 at UPB.
2x ICPC South America–North Finals competitor (2024 & 2026) with deep expertise in algorithms, data structures, and C++ / Java optimization.
Lead researcher on SEMPIA — an AI and gamified competitive programming virtual judge, distinguished as a RedColSi 2026 National Finalist.
Production experience shipping enterprise cloud platforms, Kafka event-driven microservices, SAP integrations, and React Native apps on Google Play.

projects.name: SEMPIA — AI & GAMIFIED VIRTUAL JUDGE
projects.description: Full competitive programming training engine featuring virtual judge verdicts, gamified challenges, rankings, and AI progressive hint generation. RedColSi 2026 National Finalist with SIINFO.

projects.name: PHARMACONSULTAS ENTERPRISE
projects.description: Comprehensive pharmacy ecosystem: drug commerce, appointment scheduling, digital clinical records, and family subscriptions. Shipped companion React Native app on Google Play.

projects.name: TERRAFY — PLANT GROWTH ANALYTICS
projects.description: Data-driven hydroponic plant-growth analysis and simulation platform powered by mathematical models, environmental telemetry, and analytical APIs.

projects.name: GYM MANAGEMENT CRM
projects.description: Enterprise trainee/trainer administration, secure authentication, audit logging, and weekly trainer metrics. Architected with strict Spec-Driven Development standards.

projects.name: NEXUS BATTLE IV & REALTIME CHAT
projects.description: Tactical turn-based multiplayer battle arena featuring real-time bidirectional WebSocket chat rooms and dynamic auction bidding mechanisms.
